_doc_truoc: 96 duong bao lo PK Park Village o TOA DO GOC krpano (ath, atv), doi tu `lo-park-village.json` bang phep dong dang trong `01-CONG-CU/can-matbang-flycam/`. atv=90 la nhin thang xuong.

can._doc: matbang(X,Y) -> dat(sx,sy): sx=k*cos*(X-cx)-k*sin*(Y-cy); sy=k*sin*(X-cx)+k*cos*(Y-cy). Roi ath=atan2(sx,-sy), atv=asin(1/sqrt(sx^2+sy^2+1)).
